snippet.title: Dead or Alive 6 Last Round × The King of Fighters XIV Collaboration Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/JP0106-PPSA34363_00-APPDOA6LR0000001

Mai Shiranui and Kula Diamond from the highly popular SNK fighting game THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIV, will be joining the cast of DEAD OR ALIVE 6 Last Round as collaborative DLCs alongside the newly enhanced stage, LOST PARADISE (OBORO). 

DEAD OR ALIVE 6 Last Round and DEAD OR ALIVE 6 Last Round Core Fighters are scheduled to release June 25, 2026 on PlayStation®5.

#ps5 #ps5games #deadoralive #thekingoffightersxiv 

Rated Mature
